name: Unturned
description: Free-to-play blocky zombie survival. Dedicated server (U3DS) installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).

variables.label: Server instance name
variables.description: Name of the folder under Servers/ that holds this server's config and saves.

notes: Server settings live in Servers/<name>/Server/Commands.dat (Name, Port, Password, Map, Perspective ...) — created after the first start. The A2S query port is always game port + 1. Windows hosts: set the start command override to ServerHelper.bat +InternetServer/{{WORLD_NAME}}.
